q: Will applying affect my credit score?
a: No. All five partners pre-qualify with a soft check. A hard inquiry happens only if you accept a loan from LendingClub.

q: What if I am not approved?
a: Each partner uses different criteria, so patients declined by one are often approved by another. Our coordinator helps you try the next one.

q: Can I split between two partners?
a: Yes. Some patients combine a 0% plan for part of the fee with a longer-term loan for the rest.
The $250 reservation deposit is paid by card. The rest can be financed in full.
